title: Field norm preserves integrality over the integers
statement: Let $E$ be a field of characteristic zero which is finite-dimensional over $\mathbf Q$ [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. For $x\in E$ define $N_{E/\mathbf Q}(x)$ to be the determinant of the $\mathbf Q$-linear map $z\mapsto xz$ on $E$ [def-weil-endomorphism-determinant]. If $x$ is an algebraic integer [def-weil-algebraic-integer], then $N_{E/\mathbf Q}(x)\in\mathbf Q$ is an algebraic integer.
